title: Multimodal Reference Subtraction, Drone Voiceprint and Three-Dimensional Sound Meter for Drone Localization
description: Python package and low-cost hardware for 3D acoustic localization of drones with a six-microphone rigid spherical array (D = 160 mm): rigid-sphere sensor model with hardware errors, reference subtraction, drone voiceprint classification, sphere-steered harmonic SRP-PHAT, Kalman tracking, and an active mode with rotor silence windows; evaluation on the real in-flight DREGON recordings and a network-blocked (offline) run. Version 3.0 adds a 12-channel Raspberry Pi Pico + INMP441 microphone array with one shared clock, live direction finding that runs on a Raspberry Pi (32-bit), two servo-driven camera heads that follow the acoustic estimate for visual verification, orientation sensors (BNO085, MPU-6050), Arabic wiring diagrams and a hardware test runbook.
